web-guide-idea-63.audience: Learners who enjoy practising an Indian language socially.
web-guide-idea-63.offer: Host a club with a clear theme and guided participation. Shared practice makes the session valuable even when learners make mistakes.
web-guide-idea-63.steps.0: Choose a situation and a few useful phrases.
web-guide-idea-63.steps.1: Run a speaking game with fair turns.
web-guide-idea-63.steps.2: Review expressions and ask everyone to use one in a new sentence.
web-guide-idea-63.equipment: A phone, earphones and prepared prompts.
web-guide-idea-63.returnReason: Offer a progression of themes and keep a friendly, consistent routine.
web-guide-idea-63.promotion: Record a short invitation in the language and explain the proficiency level.

web-guide-idea-63.metadataDescription: Bring learners together to practise an Indian language through conversation and shared activities. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
